defs.def: to go up sth towards the top 攀登；爬

ex.s: He pushed a chair onto the balcony, and climbed up   59   （see）them.
ex.t: 他把一把椅子推到阳台上，爬上去（第59空，see）他们。

ex.s: Two hours before my husband came back home from another job interview, my daughter climbed up to grab a glass vase from a high shelf.
ex.t: 在我丈夫又一次面试回家前两小时，我女儿爬上去够高处架子上的一个玻璃花瓶。

ex.s: I climbed and climbed． There was nothing but just green bushes and these steps． I had to reach the top!
ex.t: 现在我们生活在一个充满"做不到"的态度的世界里。我们都会跌倒。我们都有疑虑和遗憾。但我们仍然必须攀登，梦想着我们山顶上有什么。怪物可能会出现，或者黑夜将会降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes． We all fall down． We all have doubts and regrets． Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain． Monsters may appear or the night will fall． But never ever give up on your dream!
ex.t: 如今我们生活在一个被“做不到”态度包围的世界。我们都会跌倒。我们都有疑虑和悔恨。但我们仍须攀登，梦想山顶的风景。怪物可能出现，夜幕可能降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: In my early thirties, I decided to climb Mount Kilimanjaro, the highest mountain in Africa at 5, 895 meters above sea level.
ex.t: 三十岁出头时，我决定攀登非洲最高峰、海拔5895米的乞力马扎罗山。

ex.s: Over the next five days, the climb got ____26____difficult.
ex.t: 在接下来的五天里，攀登变得____26____更加艰难。

ex.s: Every year about 40,000 people attempt to climb Kilimanjaro, the highest mountain in Africa.
ex.t: 每年约有4万人尝试攀登非洲最高峰乞力马扎罗山。

defs.def: to move somewhere, especially with difficulty or effort （尤指吃力地向某处）爬
to go up mountains or climb rocks as a hobby or sport 登山，攀岩（作为业余爱好或运动）

ex.s: Bailey then ____27____ to let Lenoue climb onto her back and carried her all the way to the finish line, then another 300 feet to where Lenoue could get ____28____ attention.
ex.t: 贝利随后____27____让勒努爬上她的背，一路背着她到了终点线，然后又走了300英尺，到了勒努能接受____28____救治的地方。

ex.s: 58   you climb into an arctic-like zone with   59   snow and the glaciers that may soon disappear.
ex.t: 58  你爬进一个像北极一样的区域，那里有____雪和可能很快消失的冰川。

ex.s: Never let anyone tell you， "You can't．" Dream big and climb high！
ex.t: （3）根据第4段，你会如何描述作者的个性？（不超过10个词）

ex.s: He saw a steep uphill climb before him.
ex.t: 他看到前方有一段陡峭的上坡路。

defs.def: to go higher in the sky 爬升；上升
to slope upwards 倾斜上升
to grow up a wall or frame （沿墙或构架）攀缘生长
to increase in value or amount 温度、国家的货币等

ex.s: A regular character in the letters was Polar Bear,who once climbed the North Pole (an actual pole in this case) and fell through the roof of Father Christmas’s house.
ex.t: 字母中的一个普通人物是北极熊，他曾经爬过北极（在这种情况下是实际的极点） ，从圣诞老人家的屋顶上掉了下来。

defs.def: to move to a higher position or social rank by your own effort （靠自己的努力）晋升，提高社会地位
an act of climbing up a mountain, rock or large number of steps; a period of time spent climbing 攀登；攀缘；爬阶梯；攀登用的时间

ex.s: People celebrate the festival by climbing mountains, appreciating chrysanthemum flowers and drinking chrysanthemum wine.
ex.t: 人们通过爬山、欣赏菊花和喝菊花酒来庆祝节日。

ex.s: We managed to leave this spot to climb higher because of the spare time until sunset.
ex.t: 由于距离日落还有空闲时间，我们设法离开这个地点爬到更高的地方。

ex.s: What if the spider had been climbing the wrong corner of the cave?
ex.t: 让听众参与进来。

ex.s: They involve difficult climbing.
ex.t: 它们都包含艰难的攀爬。

ex.s: I took the dogs out four times a day, and I worried that Tilly ______53______ climbing the stairs could reopen the wound.
ex.t: 我每天带狗出去四次，担心蒂莉（第53空）爬楼梯会让伤口重新裂开。

ex.s: When I was a little girl， my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain． One day after school， while exploring the green woods of this magnificent mountain， I almost fell on a set of stairs． What could these steps lead to？ Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon． I started climbing up those strangely mysterious steps．
ex.t: 我小时候，全家搬到大山脚下的一座小镇。一天放学后，在探索这座雄伟青山的绿林时，我差点绊倒在一组台阶上。这些台阶通向何处？好奇心占了上风，因为我知道天快黑了。我开始爬上那些神秘怪异的台阶。

ex.s: He climbed a mountain.
ex.t: 他爬了一座山。

ex.s: While climbing Mount Qomolangma might be a step too far, you have a healthy sense of adventure.
ex.t: 虽然攀登珠穆朗玛峰可能太远，但您有一种健康的冒险感。

ex.s: For these people, climbing Qomolangma is an experience like no other, making some feel weak and others, powerful.
ex.t: 对于这些人来说，攀登珠穆朗玛峰是一种与众不同的体验，让一些人感到虚弱，另一些人则感到强大。

ex.s: Psychologist Frank Farley has spent years studying people who jump out of planes and drive fast cars, as well as those who climb Qomolangma.
ex.t: 心理学家弗兰克·法利（ Frank Farley ）花了数年时间研究从飞机上跳下来开快车的人，以及攀登珠穆朗玛峰的人。

ex.s: 21．（10分）Some people live to climb the highest mountains． Some people live only dreaming about it while others live to avoid ever climbing at all． But one thing is certain， all people encounter mountains in their life．
ex.t: 21．（10分）有些人活着是为了攀登最高的山峰。有些人只活在梦想里，而另一些人活着则完全避免去爬。但有一件事是确定的：所有人一生中都会遇到山。

defs.def: a mountain or rock which people climb up for sport （登山或攀岩运动的）山，岩

ex.s: （1）What made the author start to climb up the stairs to the mountain top？（no more than 5 words）
ex.t: （4）你如何理解最后一段中划线的句子？（不超过5个词）

ex.s: The hot spring at the foot of the mountain is something you must try after the climb.
ex.t: 山脚下的温泉是你爬完山一定要试的。

ex.s: But something inside me was going to climb that mountain at all cost． I could hardly wait to try this adventure again．
ex.t: （1）是什么促使作者开始爬通往山顶的台阶？（不超过5个词）

ex.s: To survive in the forest, animals must climb, jump or fly across the gaps.
ex.t: 要在森林中生存，动物必须爬、跳或飞过空隙。

defs.def: an increase in value or amount 增值；升值；增加
progress to a higher status, standard or position （地位、标准、身分的）跃升，提高，晋升
